name: Discord
author: NotCavnfox
description: A Discord bot for your server: link accounts, live library tiles, requests and ready pings.
long_description: Runs a Discord bot inside HolyArrs. Members link their Discord account to their HolyArrs account with a one-time code, then see self-updating tiles of recently added and watched titles, make requests from Discord, and get a message when a request is ready. Names on the watch leaderboard are opt-in.
how_it_works: Create a Discord application and bot, and invite it to your server.
Paste the bot token and your server and channel ids in the plugin settings.
Members join your Discord server and run /link.
They type the code under My account, Linked plugins.

settings.label: Bot token
settings.help: From the Bot tab of your application at discord.com/developers.

settings.label: Server id
settings.help: Right-click your Discord server, Copy Server ID (Developer Mode on).

settings.label: Invite link
settings.help: An https://discord.gg/... invite shown on the Home card in HolyArrs.

settings.label: Dashboard channel id
settings.help: Channel for the self-updating tiles. Leave empty to turn tiles off.

settings.label: Announcements channel id
settings.help: Channel for new-title posts. Leave empty to turn them off.

settings.label: Admin role id
settings.help: Members with this role can use admin commands.

settings.label: Linked role id
settings.help: Role given to members once they link. Optional.

settings.label: Tile refresh (minutes)
settings.help: How often the tiles refresh. 1 to 1440.

settings.label: Discord card on Home
settings.help: Shows every signed-in user how to join and link.
